findings.title: Split review usage is discarded after the first part
findings.description: Description: `_run_part` stamps a usage record on each part, but `_review` folds those results into one `ActionResult`. The fold in `squadron/pipeline/actions/review_fold.py` keeps only the first part’s metadata, so usage from later parts is lost. Because `sq stats reviews` excludes artifacts with a `runId`, that spend is not recovered from the individual artifacts either. Aggregate the part records during the fold so run totals include every model call.

findings.title: Compact actions omit usage on prompt-only runs and failures
findings.description: Description: The prompt-only path runs `/compact` but returns without reading or stamping SDK usage, so it is counted as an unrecorded LLM action. In the SDK path, the broad exception handler returns a failed result without recording telemetry attached to a `ProviderError`. Both paths therefore lose spend that the stats report is expected to include; capture prompt-only result telemetry and preserve failure telemetry in the failed result.

findings.title: Standalone review stats can mislabel subscription cost as spend
findings.description: Description: `_record` can recover an alias only from `requestedModel`, but review artifacts emit that field only when the answering model differs from the requested model. For a normal review using a subscription-tier alias, the report therefore cannot identify the alias and `cost_cell` renders a provider-reported amount as ordinary `prov` cost instead of `api-rate equiv.` Persist the selected alias or cost tier in the artifact and use it when building the report row.
